payload.description_html: Overview of the (partially interpreted) taphonomic situation and exhibition setting of Argovisaurus martafernandezi (PIMUZ A/III 5279). A overview of all the restored blocks restored as exhibited. B interpretative drawing of the overview showing the separately collected blocks. Notes: The exact location of blocks 1 and 5 is unknown, they have been restored to their most logical taphonomic location. The right angular and left jugal have been separately collected and placed as best guesses
